essence: The rite is approved even when disease arises among all four social classes.
The foremost twice-born should listen to the instruction given for the destruction of all portents.
One should devoutly make an auspicious peak structure so that the middle section is properly established.
The structure must be mirror-like in appearance and richly adorned.
Two platforms measuring five or six hastas should be constructed.
